source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical-Body and Chassis, p.12-17

procedures.title: Lighting (headlamp) switch replacement
steps: (Continued) Corvette: remove the screws along the top and left side of the instrument panel and pull the panel forward to reach the switch.
Reach under the panel, press the switch shaft retainer and pull out the knob and shaft.
Remove the ferrule nut and take the switch out of the panel.
Disconnect the vacuum hoses from the Corvette switch, tagging each hose position.
Unplug the multi-contact connector; a screwdriver can be used at the side of the switch to pry it off.
Plug the connector onto the new switch, reconnect the vacuum hoses, and reassemble in reverse order.
notes: See figure 26 in the manual for the shaft retainer.

procedures.title: Windshield wiper switch replacement
steps: Remove the screws from the upper center console plate marked "Corvette".
Unplug the wiring from the switch.
Lift the switch and plate out of the console.
Hold the switch arm with small locking pliers, carefully pry the knob off, then remove the switch screws.
To install, first put a small rod into the switch arm before pushing the knob onto the arm from outside the trim plate, then reverse the removal steps.

procedures.title: Stoplight switch replacement
steps: Unplug the harness connector at the switch.
Remove the retaining nut if fitted and unscrew the switch from its bracket.
Corvette: remove the screw holding the switch bracket to the brake pedal housing.
Install: line up the switch bracket on the brake pedal housing and fit the screw (see figure 29 in the manual).
Plug the connector back onto the switch...
